blurb: The Amos Judson House, built in 1810 on what is believed to be the property of the original French Fort. Edinboro University sponsored an archaeological dig there and although few artifacts from the colonial period were found, large areas of wood charcoal in the vicinity of the Judson House suggest the remains of either the French or British forts (both were destroyed by fire).
